title: Buttery Garlic Green Beans
nutrition_tip: This easy, 5-ingredient green bean recipe featuring fresh green beans sautéed in…

ingredients.name: 1 pound fresh green beans, trimmed and snapped in half
0.125 teaspoon lemon-pepper seasoning, or more to taste

steps.text: Place green beans into a large skillet and cover with water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until beans just start to soften, 3 to 5 minutes.
Drain and return to the skillet. Add butter and stir until melted, 1 to 2 minutes.
Add garlic; cook until tender and fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes.
Season with lemon-pepper seasoning and salt before serving.
